query FlxChatList($filter: FlxChatFilter, $search: String, $label: String, $channel: String, $first: Int = 50, $after: String) {
  flxChats(
    filter: $filter
    search: $search
    label: $label
    channel: $channel
    first: $first
    after: $after
  ) {
    nodes {
      ...FlxChatFields
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      endCursor
    }
    totalCount
  }
}

9d8fdee7b9fe4a4a7990403133db1fb69a4561d9:
query FlxChatUpdates($since: String!, $after: Int, $chatId: ID, $afterChat: Int) {
  flxChatUpdates(
    since: $since
    after: $after
    chatId: $chatId
    afterChat: $afterChat
  ) {
    rev
    continueRev
    continueId
    truncated
    messagesTruncated
    unread
    chats {
      ...FlxChatFields
    }
    messages {
      ...FlxChatMessageFields
    }
    incoming {
      databaseId
      chatId
      title
      body
    }
    connections {
      id
      label
      color
      state
    }
  }
}
